content: OpenALPR Cloud API is a commercial ANPR service. It accepts an image and returns JSON with plate candidates, confidence, and vehicle info. OpenALPR was acquired by Motorola Solutions; the cloud API has been de-emphasized in favor of on-premise/licensed deployments, so its maintenance status is uncertain. For a new project, Plate Recognizer or Google Vision OCR are safer external choices; local Tesseract remains the offline fallback.
